If your home smells like rotten eggs, do not flip a light switch.
That smell is added to gas so you notice a leak, and one small spark can set it off.
So do not turn anything on or off. No lights, no appliances, not even the doorbell.
Do not strike a match or light a candle.
And do not go hunting for the leak yourself.
Get everyone out of the house, right away.
Do not use your phone until you are well away from the building.
Then call your gas company or your emergency services.
Stay out until they tell you it is safe to go back in.
And if the smell is ever strong, or you are not sure, leave first and call second.
